mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion (potassium, magnesium) which is compounded by lactulose-induced osmotic diarrhea, increasing risk of hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and dehydration.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly; ensure adequate fluid intake; consider potassium supplementation if needed; assess for signs of electrolyte imbalance.
